propositions: Provider-prefixed model identifiers (anthropic:claude-opus, openai:gpt-5.4) passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError and silently drop rows from cost totals with no warning
Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows are unpriced while Bedrock rows price correctly, creating asymmetric bias in provider cost comparisons despite all models being resolvable by bare form
The LookupError is caught and converted to unpriced without distinguishing between genuinely unknown models and mis-formatted identifiers
genai_prices resolves bare model ids (claude-opus-4-8, gpt-5.4) but fails on the provider-qualified forms stored by agent_call.py after the provider-seam epic
A provider-aware translation layer is required that decides model_ref format by registry membership rather than prefix parsing to handle asymmetric Bedrock AWS id shapes
